scope.question: Turn outline → add items/fields → parallel primary-source research → validate → conflict audit → report → user decision → resume/refresh into a reusable factory declared in code.
out_of_scope: candidate control of protected tests, graders, permissions, policy or promotion
scope.unit_of_work: ResearchProject aggregate pinned to a factory digest with versioned Item, Field, Claim, Observation, Conflict, Decision, Attempt, Receipt and Report artifacts.
scope.fully_self_improving: Maximum safe meaning is automatic proposal, offline evaluation, non-authoritative shadow, bounded canary, monitoring and rollback; protected controls and promotion authority remain external.

verified_capabilities.capability: Separate outline, item addition, field addition, parallel research and reporting. Deep research scans JSON and skips only valid items; requires direct URLs, access dates, conflicts and uncertainty.
verified_capabilities.limit: Bundled validator checks field-name coverage, not truth, entailment, citation accuracy or source independence.

verified_capabilities.capability: Git-versioned `v1alpha1` factory definitions include agents, automations, runners, benchmarks, scorers, skills and webhooks. A foreman routes service-resident work items and pauses for key human decisions. Sampled LLM scorers can trigger failure-grouping follow-up PRs. Nothing is adopted automatically.
verified_capabilities.limit: No exhaustive public state/event schema, research evidence model, or independent effectiveness result. Work items/runs/metrics are not stored in definition files.

verified_capabilities.capability: Temporal persists/replays histories; Activities are at-least-once. LangGraph checkpoints thread state and interrupts pause for input.
verified_capabilities.limit: Agent/tool side effects still need idempotency, retention, migration and security. Model/web replay is not deterministic.

verified_capabilities.capability: Reusable workflows, token permissions, environments and attestations can separate execution/evaluation/promotion. JSON Schema, CloudEvents, W3C PROV and SLSA supply complementary structure/event/provenance primitives.
verified_capabilities.limit: They do not decide research truth or safely compensate arbitrary cancellation.

supported: Separate versioned desired definition from durable runtime state.
Resume from matching validated digests, not file existence.
Parallelize bounded independent units and join deterministically.
Link report claims to immutable observations.
Treat generated grading as a calibrated signal, not authority.

independent_challenges.finding: SWE-Bench+ found leakage and suspicious weak-test passes; scores fell after filtering.
AgentDojo found prompt-injection/security-utility tradeoffs in tool agents.
GitHub Security Lab shows privileged workflow_run can execute hostile PR artifacts/code.

missing: semantic guarantees from the current validator
portable deterministic replay across changing models and web content
evidence_and_limits.status_rule: VERIFIED, INFERRED, CONFLICTING, UNKNOWN, RETRACTED; vendor metrics remain VENDOR_REPORTED until independent reproduction.

roles.authority: state, leases, dispatch, retry, join, budget; not intent or promotion
read assigned inputs and write isolated candidates
promote immutable digest; separate from proposer
pause, cancel, reconcile, rollback, audited break-glass

actors_and_authority.separation: Distinct identities/stores for proposer, fetcher, evaluator and promoter; short-lived phase/project/host-scoped capabilities.
actors_and_authority.trust: Primary/versioned observations outrank summaries, but recency/authority never suppress direct contradiction.

complete_state_catalog.terminal: COMPLETE binds a validated report digest; cancellation preserves partials/compensation; failed names invariant; supersede/archive retain provenance.

guards: no blocking conflict or only explicit signed exception
effects: write content-addressed artifact temp → validate → atomic manifest publish
record every external effect and reconciliation handle
transition_contract.idempotency: project+phase+item/source+input digest+factory digest+purpose; duplicate returns prior receipt and never overwrites a different digest.
transition_contract.retry: Only typed transient failures; capped exponential backoff+jitter, honor Retry-After. Auth/license/schema/policy failures pause.
transition_contract.invalidation: Dependency DAG: objective change invalidates plan/results/audit/report; field change invalidates validation/report but can reuse observations; source content change invalidates affected claims; renderer-only change invalidates report. Create new versions.
transition_contract.reconciliation: Compare log, projections, leases, manifests and external runs; mark expired leases LOST, adopt only exact matching artifacts, replay outbox, quarantine orphans, surface ambiguous side effects.
transition_contract.cancellation: Fence leases, stop dispatch, request cooperative stop, then terminate; compensate only declared reversible effects and preserve partial evidence.

artifact_contracts.storage: Git for desired definition and small decision/index artifacts; append-only DB/event store for runtime truth; content-addressed object store for snapshots/reports. Secrets/raw restricted content stay out of Git. Attest release bundles and verify identity/digest.

conversation_and_handoffs.durable: Every clarification, correction, approval, rejection, deferral and cancellation is a versioned DecisionRecord. Transcript is provenance, not authority; execution binds to the effective decision digest.
protocol: Question includes ID, why blocked, exact options/default, affected artifacts, silence risk and deadline.
Authenticate reply; preserve original text plus normalized answer, actor/time/channel locator.
Decision becomes EFFECTIVE only when actor is authorized and bound inputs are current.
Edits supersede, never rewrite; changed digests invalidate approvals/downstream artifacts.
Handoff includes state, effective decisions, open questions/conflicts, completed/remaining work, budget, artifact map and one next action.
Compaction cites immutable IDs and never replaces decisions/evidence.
Resume reports reused, revalidated, invalidated and newly fetched artifacts.
conversation_and_handoffs.silence: No inferred consent for material scope, cost, restricted sources, legal/privacy, publication or promotion. Policy may apply a logged expiring undoable default only for low-risk reversible choices.

orchestration_and_composition.fanout: Default one item per isolated worker. Optionally fan out sources inside an item only when claim partitions are independent. Controller caps global/project/host concurrency, token/time/cost and egress.
orchestration_and_composition.join: Snapshot expected approved item IDs and input digests. Join when each is VALID, approved BLOCKED/UNCERTAIN, or terminal failure under acceptance policy. Late/stale-fence writes are quarantined. Deterministic ordering is stable item ID.
orchestration_and_composition.dependency: Explicit DAG supports subfactories: discovery, GitHub/repository inspection, papers, validation, conflict audit and report. Child receives least context/capabilities and returns artifact refs, not authoritative prose.
orchestration_and_composition.lease: Attempt ID + fencing token + expiry + heartbeat. Reclaim after expiry; write requires current fence.
orchestration_and_composition.budget: Per-run/item/source quotas for wall time, requests, tokens, money, bytes and retries. Near-limit stops discovery before validation; exhausted becomes BUDGET_EXHAUSTED and asks for choice.
orchestration_and_composition.cleanup: Revoke credentials; close browsers/sandboxes; remove worktrees/temp objects; expire raw prompts/snapshots by policy; retain manifest, decisions, receipts, digests and audit tombstones.
orchestration_and_composition.engine_selection: Start with file/SQLite/PostgreSQL controller and atomic manifests. Use Temporal for long cross-system waits/recovery. Use Argo for Kubernetes batch DAGs. GitHub Actions is protected CI/promotion, not sole long-lived state.

deterministic_ask: objective/audience/decision ambiguity changes items, fields or conclusion
new item/field materially changes cost, policy or acceptance
source requires credentials/payment/terms, personal data or non-public material
two authoritative current sources materially conflict
no primary source for a decision-critical claim
required result blocked, stale or semantically invalid
budget/time limit reached or projected overrun exceeds approved bound
any evaluator, hidden test, policy, permission, trust root, retention or promotion change
deterministic_approval: initial material scope when requested or approval_between_batches
canary exposure and final promotion per risk policy
automatic_continue: retry known transient fetch within cap
conditional GET and unchanged digest reuse
human_need_policy.probabilistic: Scores can prioritize review only after calibration. Ask when calibrated probability of material misinterpretation exceeds policy threshold OR expected loss p(harm)×impact exceeds approved bound. Never use an uncalibrated model confidence to waive a deterministic gate. Underpowered/conflicting scores are inconclusive, not pass.
human_need_policy.timeout: Reminder then PAUSED. Never convert silence to material consent.

factory_as_code_schema.compatibility: Reject unknown majors; pure tested migrations; pin subfactories/schemas/tools/models/routes by immutable digest. Warp v1alpha1 inspires but is not wire-compatible.

automatic: cluster failures and draft one-hypothesis prompt/route/retry/model changes
offline replay on public plus externally curated private temporal holdout
metric monitor, auto-abort and compatible rollback
protected_outside_candidate: hidden tests/answers and grader rubric/weights/thresholds/dataset inclusion
self_improvement_boundary.promotion: Independent evaluator verifies candidate digest/provenance/protected suite and reports repeated trials, slices, CIs, cost, shadow and canary. Missing/stale/conflicting/underpowered evidence is INCONCLUSIVE. External authority promotes.
self_improvement_boundary.rollback: Automatic only to tested compatible digest with reversible effects; otherwise freeze/stop/escalate/preserve evidence.
not_safely_autonomous: truth when material primary sources conflict

acceptance: decision-critical claims primary-backed or explicit uncertain/conflicting
report maps citations to claim graph
validation_strategy.caveat: Finite tests cannot prove factual completeness or no rare agent failure; challenge sampling/corrections remain required.

implementation_recommendation.decision: Build a small deterministic controller around existing skills; chats and generic agents are not the durable control plane or grader.
mvp: Stable IDs, digests, temp→validate→rename and ledger.
Semantic/URL lint beside current coverage validator.
Fenced one-item-worker fanout, digest resume, deterministic join.
Evidence index/conflict audit before report; protect decisions/evaluators.
next: Independent offline/shadow evaluator then approved canary/rollback.
implementation_recommendation.engine_choice: Temporal only when long waits/recovery warrant it; Argo for Kubernetes batch; GitHub reusable workflow for protected verification/promotion.
implementation_recommendation.buy_limit: Warp is a useful reference/runner, but Early Access v1alpha1, service state, LLM scorers and review-only improvement do not replace this evidence/state/governance model.

conflicts.topic: definition as code versus runtime truth
conflicts.evidence: Warp calls files source of truth but explicitly says work items, runs and metrics never enter them (https://docs.warp.dev/factories/factory-as-code/).
conflicts.resolution: Git is desired definition; event/database/object stores are actual runtime/evidence truth. Bind both by digests and reconcile.

conflicts.evidence: Temporal replays durable workflow history, while Activities may execute at least once; LangGraph resumes a node from its start (https://docs.temporal.io/workflow-definition; https://docs.langchain.com/oss/python/langgraph/interrupts).
conflicts.resolution: Keep LLM/web/tool calls outside deterministic code; use idempotency keys, fencing, atomic manifests and effect reconciliation.

conflicts.evidence: JSON Schema/current validator checks shape/field presence, while SWE-Bench+ demonstrates passing weak or contaminated oracles can overstate performance (https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12; https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.06992).
conflicts.resolution: Layer semantic entailment, citation, independence, conflict and expert challenge checks over structural validation.

conflicts.evidence: Warp labels the factory self-improving but documents follow-up PRs and says nothing is adopted without review (https://docs.warp.dev/factories/how-factories-work/; https://docs.warp.dev/factories/measure-and-improve/self-improvement/).
conflicts.resolution: Use proposal/evaluation/shadow/canary/rollback language; never claim recursive self-governance.

conflicts.evidence: Workflow systems support fanout, but no cited study proves more research agents improve decision accuracy; shared prompts/models/sources correlate errors.
conflicts.resolution: Partition independent items, dedupe shared evidence, use deterministic join and measure against a single-worker baseline.

conflicts.evidence: Many official pages are undated living documentation; snapshots may be legally/technically unavailable.
conflicts.resolution: Record access/final URL/ETag/Last-Modified/body digest and lawful snapshot; pin repository/standard versions; flag unsnapshotted claims and refresh selectively.

conflicts.evidence: GitHub states attestations require verification and are not security guarantees; PROV represents lineage but does not authenticate it (https://docs.github.com/en/actions/concepts/security/artifact-attestations; https://www.w3.org/TR/prov-o/).
conflicts.resolution: Protected verifier checks signer, subject, predicate, source/builder and policy; factual review remains separate.

conflicts.topic: LLM scorer convenience versus independent oracle
conflicts.evidence: Warp scorer is an LLM classifier, OpenAI/Anthropic advise calibration, and independent leakage/injection evidence shows gaming/failure risk.
conflicts.resolution: Deterministic invariants first; protected human-curated temporal holdouts and blinded expert sampling; inconclusive never auto-passes.

uncertainties.unknown: The requested 2026-09-13 cutoff is treated as the research snapshot, but living pages lack immutable revision dates and may change.
uncertainties.impact: Product/API/schema claims need a deployment-time recheck and stored digest.

uncertainties.unknown: Warp Factories is Early Access; public docs do not expose a complete machine-readable factory schema, state/event history API, retention guarantees or independent outcome denominators.
uncertainties.impact: Do not make Warp the only system of record or assume compatibility beyond documented files.

uncertainties.unknown: No universal evidence freshness interval exists.
uncertainties.impact: Repository-specific policy must classify volatility/criticality; high-risk sources may require event-driven or pre-publication refresh.

uncertainties.unknown: No universal model-confidence, conflict or source-count threshold predicts factual accuracy.
uncertainties.impact: Calibrate on domain cases and retain deterministic/human gates.

uncertainties.unknown: Lawful source snapshotting, robots/terms, deletion and PII constraints differ by source/jurisdiction.
uncertainties.impact: Some evidence can retain only metadata/digest/quote; legal/privacy owner decides.

uncertainties.unknown: Offline and shadow gains may not predict report decision quality or net reviewer cost.
uncertainties.impact: Canary narrowly and measure delayed corrections, reviewer effort and accepted-decision value.

uncertainties.unknown: Exact scale at which PostgreSQL should be replaced/supplemented by Temporal/Argo is workload-specific.
uncertainties.impact: Instrument queue age, crash recovery, history size and operator cost before adopting complexity.

uncertainties.unknown: Automated claim entailment/conflict extraction has unknown false-negative rates for each domain/language.
uncertainties.impact: Use expert samples, adversarial goldens and explicit UNKNOWN/CONFLICTING states.

confidence.overall: High for the proposed separation, state/idempotency/provenance contracts and documented workflow primitives; medium for the detailed factory design because it is an evidence-led synthesis; low for vendor-independent ROI, universal thresholds and unattended semantic adjudication.
high: Warp documented file/runtime and review-only self-improvement boundaries
need for protected evaluator/promotion separation and digest-bound resume
medium: claim graph plus selective invalidation reduces refresh work without missed dependencies
one-item fanout is a good default
semantic lint plus challenge audit improves report quality
low: specific budgets, TTLs, confidence thresholds or canary sample sizes
net economic benefit in an unmeasured repository
safe automatic publication or universal autonomous truth resolution
confidence.claim_level: Each result claim must carry its own status/confidence/evidence; this aggregate rating must not override CONFLICTING/UNKNOWN records.
